page.layout: One page of text, centred title page; no margin notes. Blocks in reading order: title lines at top, decorative ornament, rule, printer's imprint at foot. Handwritten numerals in the corners (top right "26", bottom right "3v.") are not printed and are omitted. Show-through text from the reverse page is not transcribed.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the date line and the rule is not transcribed. Handwritten marks and a pen flourish near "censuræ" are not printed text. Faint show-through text from the reverse page is ignored. The "5." in the date line is set in a different type (a decorative numeral) and is copied as printed.
